items.title: Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy
items.summary: Cmpnd released dspy-wsp, a prototype DSPy optimizer for weight-space programming. A frontier LLM reads a small model’s weights, edits them in a sandbox, and tests each change, with no gradients and about $5 to $10 per run. The post Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
items.summary: Stanford researchers released Memorilla, an open-source memory system that compresses a document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B. It reaches 84.33% on FactKG using 108x fewer document tokens than full context. The post Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents
items.summary: Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control. The post Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate
items.summary: Perplexity Decider v1.3 and Flash v1.3 are open-weight decision models that return probabilities, not text. Version 1.3 adds Locate for span extraction and reports 91.6% mean accuracy on 63 query-classification tasks. The post Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
items.summary: Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that moves KV caches and weights across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage and network. Google reports over 90% lower KV transfer latency on 235B to 480B MoE models. The post Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 2.5x Faster Than Gemini 3.8 Flash
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast agentic model with a 1M-token window, 4 thinking levels and $1.50/$7.50 pricing. Google reports a 51 Artificial Analysis score and 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1. The post Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 2.5x Faster Than Gemini 3.8 Flash appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Liquid AI Releases LiquidCodec, a 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec
items.summary: Liquid AI released LiquidCodec, a ~74M-parameter streaming audio codec that powers LFM3-Audio-2B and LFM3-Omni-2B. It runs at 12.5 Hz with 12 codebooks and encodes about 361x faster than real time on a single CPU thread. The post Liquid AI Releases LiquidCodec, a 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: CopilotKit Releases OpenBot 1.0: An MIT-Licensed, Self-Hostable AI Coworker With Built-In Governance
items.summary: CopilotKit released OpenBot 1.0, an MIT-licensed, self-hostable AI coworker workspace. Companies bring their own agents, models and infrastructure, while every Bot action passes a policy check and lands in an audit trail. The post CopilotKit Releases OpenBot 1.0: An MIT-Licensed, Self-Hostable AI Coworker With Built-In Governance appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: AWS Releases AWS Emulator: A Local Copy of 200+ AWS Services Built by AI Agents
items.summary: AWS released AWS Emulator, a free, CC0-licensed local emulator of AWS APIs built from 438 API models. Autonomous agents wrote all of its code. It passes 56.6% of 42,857 published fidelity tests at launch. The post AWS Releases AWS Emulator: A Local Copy of 200+ AWS Services Built by AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.
